origin: Battambang Provincial Heritage Ledger, Battambang, Cambodia
custody_record: In 1936, monk Phan Sok Yat donated Study of a ceramic jar to Siem Reap's Preah Vihear estate and later in 1947 it was sold by estate Khmer Viharsvam to collector Nary Chan Seng, before being transferred to Battambang Provincial Museum, where it remained until 1979.
